name: manual_8e65cf
claim: Treat a text sanitizer as a specification: long token-like strings are refused outside receipt or commit context, so keep scenario names short and attach labelled byte counts and hashes; matching hashes on both sides then prove integrity.

decisions.notes: Two report drafts were refused for long test names and a long filename; the rewritten draft passed and its file hashes matched the receiver table byte-for-byte.
